mapper.insert:
SELECT CASE #{situType} WHEN '자동감지' THEN 'AUTO_' WHEN '수동감지' THEN 'MANU_' WHEN '긴급보고' THEN 'EMER_' ELSE 'SITU_' END || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '_' || LPAD(SITU_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 4, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SITUATIONS ( SITU_NO, SITU_TYPE, DNGR_TYPE, DNGR_LEVEL, SITU_STATUS, SITU_DATE, SITU_CONTENT, SITU_IMAGE, ZONE_NAME, DRONE_ID, FINDER ) VALUES ( #{situNo}, #{situType}, #{dngrType}, #{dngrLevel}, #{situStatus}, SYSDATE, #{situContent}, #{situImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zoneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{droneId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{finder, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SITUATIONS SET SITU_STATUS = '조치', START_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SITU_NO = #{situNo}
UPDATE SITUATIONS SET SITU_STATUS = #{situStatus}, END_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SITU_NO = #{situNo}

UPDATE SITUATIONS SET DNGR_TYPE = #{dngrType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DNGR_LEVEL = #{dngrLevel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SITU_STATUS = #{situStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SITU_CONTENT = #{situContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_CONTENT = #{workContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_IMAGE = #{workImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORKER = #{worker, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, END_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE SITU_NO = #{situNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SITUATIONS WHERE SITU_STATUS = '감지'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SITUATIONS WHERE SITU_STATUS = '조치'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SITUATIONS WHERE END_DATE IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_TYPE) LIKE '%자동%' THEN 1 END) AS "autoCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_TYPE) LIKE '%수동%' THEN 1 END) AS "manualCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_TYPE) LIKE '%긴급%' THEN 1 END) AS "emerCount" FROM SITUATIONS WHERE TRIM(SITU_STATUS) = '감지'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_STATUS) = '조치' THEN 1 END) AS "progressCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_STATUS) IN ('조치완료', 'APPROVE') THEN 1 END) AS "completeCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_STATUS) = '미해결' THEN 1 END) AS "unresolvedCount" FROM SITUATIONS WHERE TRIM(SITU_STATUS) != '감지'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_STATUS) = '감지' THEN 1 END) AS "pendingCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_STATUS) = '조치' THEN 1 END) AS "progressCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(SITU_STATUS) IN ('조치완료', 'APPROVE') THEN 1 END) AS "completeCount" FROM SITUATIONS WHERE TRIM(SITU_TYPE) = '긴급보고'

SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, FINDER AS finder, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_DATE AS situDate, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, WORKER AS worker, END_DATE AS endDate FROM SITUATIONS
SITU_STATUS = 'PENDING' OR SITU_STATUS = '감지' OR SITU_STATUS IS NULL
SITU_STATUS IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT', '조치', '종료')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, WORKER AS worker, ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT SITU_NO, SITU_TYPE, DNGR_TYPE, DNGR_LEVEL, SITU_STATUS, SITU_CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, ZONE_NAME, WORKER FROM SITUATIONS
AND (WORKER = #{userId} OR SITU_STATUS IN ('조치', 'APPROVE', '조치완료'))

AND (SITU_STATUS = '조치완료' OR SITU_STATUS = 'APPROVE')
ORDER BY START_DATE DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{limit} ) WHERE RNUM > #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SITUATIONS
AND (WORKER = #{userId} OR SITU_STATUS IN ('조치', 'APPROVE', '조치완료'))
AND SITU_STATUS = '조치'
AND (SITU_STATUS = '조치완료' OR SITU_STATUS = 'APPROVE')
